rationale: Build on the staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline, but decouple carry activation from recurrence activation. The current family already benefits from reverse tail reuse; this change keeps the recurrent block update schedule intact while delaying and slightly compressing anchor carry on the shallower recurrent passes. The hypothesis is that late-block recurrence should learn earlier, while anchor pull should come online later to reduce over-smoothing and preserve export-friendly tail specialization before quant-aware roundtrips. This is a compact structural edit, compile-stable, and directly targets the winning recurrent-tail path instead of another scalar sweep.
title: Delayed Tail Carry Curriculum
